doc: Nutritional care of children and adults with Ebola virus disease in treatment centres

entries.claim: 如果哺乳期妇女疑似或确诊急性埃博拉病毒病，应停止母乳喂养，并将婴儿与母亲隔离，提供母乳替代品。
entries.source_doc: Nutritional care of children and adults with Ebola virus disease in treatment centres

entries.claim: 未感染埃博拉病毒的儿童暴露于确诊埃博拉病毒病女性的母乳后，应停止母乳喂养，提供母乳替代品，并进行21天密切监测。
entries.source_doc: Nutritional care of children and adults with Ebola virus disease in treatment centres

entries.claim: 如果哺乳期女性及其婴儿均确诊埃博拉病毒病，应停止母乳喂养，将母婴分离，并提供适当的母乳替代品；但如果婴儿小于6个月且无安全替代品或无法充分护理，可以考虑不分离并继续母乳喂养。
entries.source_doc: Nutritional care of children and adults with Ebola virus disease in treatment centres

entries.claim: 从埃博拉病毒病康复的女性希望继续母乳喂养时，应等待两次连续的RT-PCR检测（间隔24小时）呈阴性后方可恢复。
entries.source_doc: Nutritional care of children and adults with Ebola virus disease in treatment centres

entries.claim: 埃博拉病毒病患者应获得至少达到各营养素推荐每日摄入量的食物。
entries.source_doc: Nutritional care of children and adults with Ebola virus disease in treatment centres

entries.claim: 在康复期，应鼓励埃博拉病毒病患者尽可能多进食。
entries.source_doc: Nutritional care of children and adults with Ebola virus disease in treatment centres

entries.claim: 如果有意识和吞咽能力，应给埃博拉病毒病患者提供食物。
entries.section: General management, diet and feeding of children and adults with Ebola virus disease
entries.source_doc: Nutritional care of children and adults with Ebola virus disease in treatment centres
